_doc: E2 worked-example fixture - FROZEN, READ-ONLY oracle. Pins the E2 tie-break expected origins for the assessment.py/fault_report rewrite (MASTER-SPEC v7 §3,§6.3,§6.4,§11, build F3). Generated deterministically by an OUT-OF-TREE builder (scratchpad build_e2.py, NOT shipped in the repo) and then FROZEN + hash-pinned by the §10 gate; once pinned a build phase MUST NOT regenerate or edit it (the §10 hash check + the builder living out-of-tree enforce this). Loader contract: IGNORE keys beginning with '_'; consume only registry/records/outcomes; hold `expected` OUT-OF-BAND (feed the impl only registry+records+outcomes, compare its output to `expected`).
_scope: This fixture exercises the POST-VERIFICATION causal-selector + two-feature attribution sub-function ONLY. Cryptographic verification (identity.verify / verify_chain) is OUT OF SCOPE here (signatures/DER are deterministic placeholders); a test MUST treat crypto as pre-verified when consuming this fixture. The verify-before-attribute crypto path + the wrong-key tamper case are covered by a SEPARATE tamper fixture (build F4), not this one.
_purpose: TWO scored outcomes of the SAME type (false_preemption) with DISTINCT in-enum origins: o1 attacker-key (validly-SIGNED uncorroborated phantom, incl. an attacker SELF-sighting; signing-key-count 1, independent-corrob 0) and o2 sensor-fed-spoof (KEYLESS lone local sighting, signing-key-count 0). Plus a distractor decision placed in the MIDDLE, with outcomes listed in REVERSE of causal-decision seq order, so positional/zip/drop-extreme pairing mispairs and ONLY an ev_id-matched causal selector + the §2/§3 TWO-FEATURE partition (signing-key-count AND recomputed-independent-corroboration) passes both. See _discrimination.

_consume.causal_selector: per outcome, select the causal decision by walking driving_input_seqs -> input record -> its ev id == outcome.ev_id, where ev id = signed_payload.payload.ev_claim.ev_id for a message input OR ev_id for a sighting input (§6.3, which now covers sighting inputs). NOT by recency/junction/seq/index/input-count/timestamp.
_consume.attribution_rule: over the causal decision's driving_input_seqs compute BOTH features: (a) signing-key-count = number of distinct non-null signing keys among the inputs; (b) independent-corroboration count = signed inputs whose key differs from the claimer's key (a self-sighting under the claimer's own key does NOT count). key-count==0 -> keyless-lone-sighting -> sensor-fed-spoof; key-count>=1 AND independent-corrob==0 -> uncorroborated-signed -> attacker-key (attributed to the claimer key); key-count>=1 AND independent-corrob>=1 (>=2 keys) -> corroborated -> legitimate. A rule that ignores key-count (counts only corroboration) wrongly returns attacker-key for the keyless case o2 and fails; a rule that counts the claimer's own self-sighting as corroboration wrongly flips o1 off attacker-key and fails.
_consume.keyless_input: a KEYLESS local sensor reading is a kind:'sighting' with sighter_key=null and signature=null (§11); it is NOT missing_metadata - it is a recognised input with signing-key-count 0 -> sensor-fed-spoof (§6.4). Its driving_input_seqs pair is [seq, null].
_consume.origin_is_class_independent: origin is decided ONLY from verified provenance (key-count + recomputed corroboration + ev_id link); it does NOT read the runtime `classification` field, the `outcome.type`, nor the claimer's authorized entity-class.
_consume.clocks: signed_payload.t / sighting.t = logical (100-104); decision.t = sim (150); outcome.t = harm-detection sim (160, AFTER all decisions).
_consume.scored_origins: the 3 provenance-decidable classes (§2/§3): keyless-lone-sighting->sensor-fed-spoof, uncorroborated-signed->attacker-key, corroborated->legitimate. This fixture asserts attacker-key (o1) AND sensor-fed-spoof (o2); both are false_preemption so outcome.type carries NO origin signal.

records._note: attacker phantom advance-claim (EV-PH), signed key att-fpr

attacker SELF-sighting for its own phantom EV-PH (SAME key att-fpr). A distinct record kind from seq2 (no B5-nonce collision) that makes D_att a >1-input decision AND tests the independence recompute: a self-sighting under the claimer's own key is NOT independent corroboration.
D_ATT (causal for o1): signing-key-count 1 (att-fpr), independent-corrob 0 (the self-sighting shares the claimer key) -> attacker-key. runtime classification LEGITIMATE NOT read for origin.

D_DISTRACTOR (referenced by NO outcome): placed in the MIDDLE of the decision seqs (4,6,8). Neither the min nor the max decision seq, so 'lowest-seq-is-distractor' drops o1's causal (seq4) and 'highest-seq-is-distractor' drops o2's causal (seq8) - both wrong. Only ev_id (no outcome matches EV-OTHER) marks it as the real distractor.
KEYLESS local sensor reading (sighter_key=null, signature=null) for EV-KL -> signing-key-count 0
D_KEYLESS (causal for o2, the HIGHEST decision seq): sole driving input is a keyless local reading -> signing-key-count 0 -> keyless-lone-sighting -> sensor-fed-spoof.

outcomes._note: LISTED FIRST but its causal decision (seq8) is the LAST decision -> outcome order != causal-seq order, so zip/index pairing mispairs. harm = the keyless sensor-spoof preemption.
LISTED SECOND but its causal decision (seq4) is the FIRST decision. SAME type+junction+t as o2, DISTINCT ev_id.

expected.rationale: o1.ev_id EV-PH matches the ev_claim in message seq2 (and the ev_id in self-sighting seq3) driving decision seq4; driving_input_seqs=[[2,att-fpr],[3,att-fpr]] are validly SIGNED (signing-key-count 1, NOT keyless) and both the claimer own key (independent-corrob 0; the self-sighting does not count) -> uncorroborated-signed -> attacker-key, attributed to att-fpr. NOT sensor-fed-spoof (needs key-count 0). runtime LEGITIMATE ignored (§3).

o2.ev_id EV-KL matches the KEYLESS sighting seq7 (ev_id branch of the §6.3 selector) driving decision seq8; seq7 has sighter_key null -> signing-key-count 0 -> keyless-lone-sighting -> sensor-fed-spoof (no key to attribute, culprit null). Same corroboration-count (0) as o1 but DIFFERENT key-count (0 vs 1): a rule that ignores key-count wrongly returns attacker-key here. §6.4: a keyless lone reading forcing a preemption is an in-scope free class, labelled sensor-fed-spoof post-hoc.

_discrimination.only_correct_impl_passes_both: ev_id-matched causal selector (covering message AND sighting inputs) + the §2/§3 two-feature (key-count AND independent-corroboration) attribution
kills: latest-at-junction/highest-seq -> seq8: right o2, WRONG o1
earliest/lowest-seq -> seq4: right o1, WRONG o2
drop-highest-seq-as-distractor -> drops seq8 (o2's real causal): o2 unresolved/WRONG
drop-lowest-seq-as-distractor -> drops seq4 (o1's real causal): o1 unresolved/WRONG
positional zip(outcomes_file_order=[o2,o1], decisions_seq_order=[4,6,8]) -> o2:4/o1:6: WRONG for both (o2 is seq8, o1 is seq4)
index/count pairing -> 2 outcomes vs 3 decisions, distractor in the middle: no clean map
time-window recency (window ends outcome.t=160, includes all t=150) -> latest seq8: right o2, WRONG o1
t-exact-match (outcome.t=160) -> no decision at t=160: picks nothing
fewest-driving-inputs -> ties at 1 (seq6,seq8), tiebreak lowest-seq seq6 (distractor): WRONG for both
key on outcome.type -> both false_preemption: no origin signal
corroboration-count-only, ignoring key-count -> attacker-key for BOTH (both corrob 0): WRONG o2
count the claimer self-sighting as corroboration -> seq4 corrob 0->1: flips o1 off attacker-key: WRONG o1
length==1 -> attacker-key -> seq4 has 2 inputs (non-attacker for o1) and seq8 has 1 (attacker for o2, wrong): WRONG on both
read runtime classification for origin -> both causal decisions LEGITIMATE, origins differ: cannot produce both
